name: Quick Co.,Ltd.
summary: Quick Co.,Ltd. engages in the recruiting, human resources service, information publishing, and internet-related businesses in Japan and internationally. The company offers personnel placement; temporary staffing, temporary-to-permanent staffing, job advertising, business contracting, and operates and consults nursery schools; and recruiting services, education and training services, and personnel and labor consulting. It also provides web promotion, printing, posting, and concierge services; as well as operating HR platforms. The company was incorporated in 1980 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.
